svg.text: Tool plate (Limn-Tool-Dock-Plate, v67 section): proposed lead-in + detent on the dowel floor
Back view (pocket side, the tool body side), dowel shown LOCKED. Rendered from the STEP mesh; red/yellow = new cuts.
lead-in: 0.8 deep at the slot edge → 0 at ~65°
if K turns the other way
Leading edges only (the side the dowel turns onto); chamfer them. The ramp is helical: depth by angle, not by height, so the whole dowel climbs at once.
Easiest in Fusion: a 0.8 x 40° helical/loft cut from the slot edge, or a sweep of a wedge around the key axis; detent = a Ø2 groove 0.15 deep along the 90° line.
balls only seat the plate: all 3 equal
